title: Viking Hiking
description:
Student Project
Viking Hiking is a student project made by a passionate team from Breda University of Applied Sciences. We worked on this project for about four months. 

It would not have been the same if we had not had your support during development. We are very curious to get your opinions and feedback so join our Discord and become part of our Community!

Об игре

Viking Hiking is a 3D Platformer featuring a buff viking called 'Bøf, son of Tøf', on a quest to reach Valhalla. Bøf carries a magic horn that he uses in an 'unconventional' way. Jump, dash and vault with the horn to overcome obstacles and explore the environment. 
Are you ready to prove yourself worthy in the eyes of the gods? 

Bøf can freely explore an entire island. It is up to you to decide which path to take to collect the necessary runes. 
Confront numerous platforming trials and devise your own way to conquer them. 
Let yourself be carried away by the beauty of this lush but challenging island!
An epic journey awaits you adventurer
description_short: Viking Hiking is a cheerful 3D Platformer. Join Bøf on his adventure to reach Valhalla. Jump, dash and use the horn as you explore a lush but challenging island! Viking Hiking is a FREE game made by second year students from Breda University.
